Foundry VTT Implementation Note: Dragonmark Spell Proficiency must be tracked by alternate means - no Dragonmark Spell Proficiency exists. Select a spell Tradition you do not have access to, and use that as a placeholder for your Dragonmark Spell Proficiency.

 

You have manifested a Siberys Mark. Siberys marks are extraordinarily rare, and to gain one immediately marks you as a valuable asset to your house. You gain or increase your Focus Pool by 1 and select a new dragonmark Focus Spell.

When you gain new dragonmark focus spells, you may select from any focus spell with the Dragonmark trait and the same trait as your Mark (e.g. Mark of Detection). The spell you select may be up to half your level rounded up.

You become legendary in Dragonmark attack rolls and DCs.
